topic: Top NYC Studios Join Arcana, a New Premium Fitness Membership

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Top NYC Studios Join Arcana, a New Premium Fitness Membership

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: Athletech News

facts.label: Article
facts.value: An Arcana membership, which starts at $325 a month for nine classes plus exclusive wellness perks, unlocks a growing list of NYC’s buzziest studios New York’s fitness studio hoppers have a new way to hop. Arcana, a newly launched premium membership, gives subscribers one account to book classes across more than 10 boutique studios in the city. Several of New York’s favorites have already signed on: Reforming Pilates, The Training Lab, Nrthrn Strong, Sui Yoga, ID Hot Yoga, Güdsport, Nofar Method, The Silhouette Method, Good Day Pilates, Elahni, Serotonin Club, Powered on Bond, First Class Form and Outershed. “We shouldn’t have to choose between variety and quality in our training,” Arcana co-founder and CEO Felicia Dodge said. She spent more than 10 years in analytics and strategy, with stops at Twitter and Visa, and earned a master’s in applied analytics at Columbia University. “Arcana makes it easier to build a consistent routine across the studios and instructors we already trust, creating a model designed to support our partners over the long term,” she said. Dodge and her co-founder, Cole Tomlinson, met as yoga instructors and found they shared the same gripe about how hard it is to train well in a city with endless options. Tomlinson, Arcana’s chief technology officer, spent a decade writing mobile software at Wayfair and Trello.

Kimberly-Clark completes US$48.7B Kenvue acquisition in wellness push 03 Nov 2026 | By Ela Jade Ünal Key takeaways Kimberly-Clark has completed its US$48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue, combining 10 billion-dollar brands. The company expects approximately US$2.1 billion in run-rate synergies from cost savings and revenue growth. The deal expands Kimberly-Clark’s reach across consumer health, personal care, women’s health, and active aging. Kimberly-Clark has completed its acquisition of Kenvue, a cash-and-stock transaction originally valued at an enterprise value of approximately US$48.7 billion. The deal brings together 10 billion-dollar brands across personal care and consumer health, with Kimberly-Clark positioning the combined company as the “preeminent global consumer health and wellness leader.” The acquisition utilizes Kimberly-Clark’s Powering Care growth engine and operating model to enhance value across the portfolio. The company underscores its forecast run-rate synergies of approximately US$2.1 billion, with its upcoming value capture plans already laid out. The deal unites major personal care and consumer health brands under the Kimberly-Clark umbrella.
